**Resubmitted: deviation (fallback target), validated ok:true.**

Changes made in response to the minimality defect:

- **Removed the duplicate notice-window language.** The insertion now reads only: *"TrueLink's fees will not increase by more than five percent (5%) in any renewal term."* Section 13's existing "no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year" stands alone, so there is no second, differently worded formulation of the same commercial term.
- **Notice-window element re-mapped to `already_met`,** with a verbatim contiguous quote from p0078 that carries the renewal mechanic and the express 30-day figure (and the plain-digit "30 days" form), and p0078 is cited in paragraphIds.
- **Price-cap element remains the sole operative change** (operation 1), curing the gap left when Section 6's one-year cost freeze expires.
- Intent checks re-run on retained text: the Section 6 freeze and most-favoured-rate covenant, the Section 12 termination cross-reference, and the 30/60-day discontinuation timelines are untouched, and the cap is confined to "any renewal term" so it does not collide with the first-year freeze. Preferred-level items (60-day Vendor reminder; lesser of CPI and 3%) are noted in the rationale only.
